create_RealFinger_instance: create a RealFinger instance with a finger type and config suffix to interface with the real robot
append_desired_action: append a desired action with joint positions or torques to the robot action timeseries
get_observation: get the robot observation at a specified time index including joint positions and velocities
reset_finger: reset the finger to target joint positions by stepping the robot for one thousand iterations
initialize_RealFinger_with_visualization: initialize a RealFinger with pyBullet visualization enabled to mirror the real robot state in simulation
